name: CompareView
intent: Compares two geo-aligned sources. `swipe` stacks them and reveals more of one as you drag a center divider; `side-by-side` splits the box into two panes. With `interactive`, the content pans (drag) and zooms (wheel); in side-by-side a lock on the divider keeps both panes in sync. Pass any nodes (images, maps, canvases) for `before`/`after`.
